assets.name: lecture_08_figure_09.png

assets.name: lecture_08_figure_10.png
assets.rationale: The factorized wave function and normalization sum are complete.
assets.subtitle_excerpt: Sum on B chi chi star, that's just one.

assets.name: lecture_08_figure_11.png
assets.rationale: All four reduced-density-matrix entries for the singlet are visible together.
assets.subtitle_excerpt: The density matrix is just equal to a half, a half.
assets.caption_hint: Single-spin density matrix in the singlet

assets.name: lecture_08_figure_12.png
assets.rationale: The discrete classical state-transition arrows are clear and minimally occluded.
assets.subtitle_excerpt: That would define the evolution of a system, just a permutation.

assets.name: lecture_08_figure_13.png
assets.rationale: The linear time-evolution equation is complete.
assets.subtitle_excerpt: Psi of t is always equal to some linear operator times psi of zero.

assets.name: lecture_08_figure_14.png
assets.rationale: The first-order unitarity expansion and H-dagger-equals-H conclusion are visible.
assets.subtitle_excerpt: The conclusion is that h dagger equals h.

assets.name: lecture_08_figure_15.png
assets.rationale: The difference quotient and differential state-evolution equation are legible.
assets.subtitle_excerpt: This tells you how the state vector of a system changes with time.
assets.caption_hint: From infinitesimal evolution to the Schrodinger equation

assets.name: lecture_08_figure_16.png
assets.rationale: The energy-eigenvalue equation and exponential phase solution are visible together.
assets.subtitle_excerpt: The angular frequency omega is equal to the energy over h-bar.
